title: Six Pilgrims
text: Six pilgrims at a well, each devoted to one of the Six, argue with rising fury, their knives close to coming out. They want a stranger to settle which god the well belongs to. They all look at you.

options.label: The Leader names one god and lets the other five be angry.

outcomes.text: Five pilgrims leave angry. The sixth stays and blesses you.

options.label: The wisest says it belongs to all six, before the knives come out.

outcomes.text: They grumble but share the water. Then they share their food.

options.label: Say the well belongs to you, and let them argue with that.

outcomes.text: All six turn on you. For once, they agree.
